q: The Beatitudes ('Blessed are the poor in spirit...', 'Blessed are the peacemakers...') were taught by Jesus in the Sermon on the ____. (P6)
explain: Matthew 5-7 details the core kingdom ethics of Jesus' Sermon on the Mount.

q: Paul wrote letters (Epistles) to early churches. The epistle famous for the 'Love Chapter' (1 Corinthians 13) emphasizes that the greatest virtue is ____. (P6)
explain: 1 Corinthians 13:13: 'Now faith, hope, and love abide, but the greatest of these is love.'

q: The Roman governor who sentenced Jesus to crucifixion despite finding no guilt in Him was ____. (P6)

explain: The Great Commission drives global Christian gospel outreach.
hint: Final command of the risen Christ.
